graders.evidence:
# Overview

source: 03cb441 · last reviewed: 2026-09-18

`acme-tool` (package.json `name`) is a Node.js package (`"type": "module"`, ES modules) that
declares one npm `bin` entry, `acme`, pointing at `src/cli/main.js`. That single fact —
`package.json` has a `bin` field *and* a dependency on `express`, a web framework — is why
`arch classify` returned two plausible archetypes (`cli`, `service`) instead of one; see
`GAP:` in [decisions](../decisions/) via the interview (`kind-ambiguous`, `architecture/_run/interview.md`).
This doc treats the repo as what the code shows: a CLI entry point that, on invocation, also
constructs (but does not start) a web server.

## What is actually here

The whole production source tree is 4 files:

| file | role |
|---|---|
| `src/cli/main.js` | npm `bin` entry point; imports and calls `core.run()` and `web.serve()` at module load time |
| `src/core/run.js` | exports `run()`, which returns `1` and does nothing else |
| `src/core/back.js` | re-exports `web.serve` as `back` — the only file in `core` that imports `web` |
| `src/web/server.js` | exports `serve(app)`, which calls `core.run()` and ignores `app` — no `.listen()` call anywhere in the repo |

There is no test file, no lockfile, no Dockerfile/IaC, and no `docs/decisions/` ADR yet
(`GAP:` — see `architecture/risks.md` and `architecture/_run/interview.md`).

## Components (`docs/reference/components.md`)

- **cli** (1 file) — the executable entry point; imports both `core` and `web`.
- **core** (2 files) — `run()` plus a re-export of `web.serve` (`back.js`), which is what creates
  the `core <-> web` import cycle also called out in `architecture/risks.md`.
- **web** (1 file, kind `webui` per `arch classify`) — `serve()`, which never mounts a route and
  never listens; `reference/ui.json` finds 0 routes and 0 `data-*` anchors, so there is no
  evidenced UI to map (`architecture/journeys/` is intentionally not written — see `architecture/_run/review.md`).

## Where to look next

- `architecture/risks.md` — what's broken or fragile, with evidence.
- `architecture/scenarios/cli-invocation.md` — the one real, evidenced code path.
- `architecture/deployment.md`, `architecture/secrets.md`, `architecture/signals.md` — GAP-heavy;
  the repo doesn't yet show a deployment target, a real log/event emitter, or dead vs. live secrets.
- `docs/reference/` — every generated table (components, deps, delivery, env, tests, fitness, api).
- `architecture/_run/interview.md` — open questions for a human (archetype, the import cycle, the unused dep).
